verdict.rationale: Capacities documents a REST API to access, create and manipulate content, and a successor API that reads and writes objects, properties, block content and daily notes. It ships with an OpenAPI 3.0 spec, an interactive reference, a TypeScript SDK and an MCP integration. Nothing claims or shows that the API matches the UI, and the Beta API is being discontinued on September 1, 2026 in favour of a new generation. missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity commitment, documented API coverage of UI features such as templates, object-type definition, smart queries, collections, sharing, export scheduling and AI features, and independent hands-on corroboration of breadth.
